description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts, specifically USD, with dynamic decimal precision and optional credits suffix. It includes functions for formatting currency amounts with optional credits, formatting USD with credits, and formatting USD amounts up to six decimal places.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with optional credits suffix, handling dynamic decimal precision based on the value's magnitude.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText
methods.description: Convenience function to format USD amounts with credits appended, using default includeCredits=true.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with up to six decimal places and thousands separators.
